sections.content: Recommendations commonly use recomendar que, aconsejar que and ser importante que followed by the subjunctive. The recommendation can also be expressed directly with deberías or te recomiendo que. At B1, focus on the common pattern: recommendation + que + subjunctive.

items.spanish: Te recomiendo que veas esta película.
items.english: I recommend that you watch this film.

items.spanish: Es importante que leas la novela antes de ver la película.
items.english: It is important that you read the novel before watching the film.

items.spanish: Te aconsejo que escuches la canción.
items.english: I advise you to listen to the song.

items.spanish: La obra merece que la conozcas mejor.
items.english: The work deserves for you to get to know it better.

sections.content: After a recommendation with que, use the present subjunctive when the person recommended to do the action is different from the person making the recommendation.
